source.embedded_license_text: This data is released under the CC0 license

audit_exclusion.reason: individual record content displayed during source and schema qualification before this freeze
audit_exclusion.set_commitment_contract: sort the 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 identifier keys in ASCII order; hash b'indusbench:oracc-ed3b:audit-exclusion-set:v1\x00', unsigned-8-byte big-endian count, then each ASCII key prefixed by its unsigned-8-byte big-endian length
audit_exclusion.enumeration_limit: the commitment avoids directly listing source identifiers but does not conceal the exclusion set from parties able to enumerate the finite public source identifier space

selection.selected_member_manifest_contract: hash b'indusbench:oracc-ed3b:selected-member-manifest:v1\x00', unsigned-8-byte big-endian selected count, then for every selected corpus member in source-identifier order append the ASCII public member path prefixed by its unsigned-8-byte big-endian length, the raw byte length as unsigned 8-byte big-endian, and the raw 32-byte SHA-256 digest

parser.required_embedded_license: This data is released under the CC0 license
parser.document_identifier_consistency: catalogue key, catalogue id_text, corpus member name, and corpus textid must agree
parser.sequence_order: recursive pre-order over cdl arrays, preserving line-start boundaries and lemma source order
parser.observation_source: only the exact non-empty f.gdl array enters the frozen annotation-stripping projection; no other f field is model-facing
parser.effective_corpus_digest_contract: hash b'indusbench:oracc-ed3b:effective-corpus:v1\x00', unsigned-8-byte big-endian document count, then for every document in source-identifier order append framed ASCII source identifier, line count, lemma count, and for each lemma append token ordinal, line ordinal, framed evaluator truth state including annotation_unknown, and framed canonical JSON of the frozen model-facing observation with UTF-8, sorted object keys, no ASCII escaping, no whitespace, and non-finite numbers forbidden; all counts and ordinals are unsigned 8-byte big-endian

observation_projection.scientific_layer: annotation-stripped transliteration-layer symbol identity; not native glyphs, photographs, palaeography, or independent visual observation
observation_projection.ordinary_atom_rule: exactly zero or one ordinary atom key; when present, hash that exact non-empty UTF-8 payload and stop descending the node; an accompanying form is ignored
observation_projection.form_atom_rule: when no ordinary atom exists, form is admitted only for an n+form+seq numeric wrapper or a form+mods modified wrapper; hash form and stop descending the node
observation_projection.wrapper_rule: a node without an atom or gap must contain exactly one non-empty approved child container; recurse in array order and do not disclose the container key
observation_projection.gap_rule: x values ellipsis and newline both become one neutral GAP; no other x value is admitted
observation_projection.damage_rule: break values missing and damaged both become one inherited boolean damage mask
observation_projection.atom_output: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 characters with no source GDL key or raw payload
observation_projection.source_domain_separation: primary transfer cannot use MTAAC-to-ED3b lexical identity; only source-neutral structure, position, repetition, damage, and frozen template features may transfer

gold_projection.annotation_unknown_scoring: the model must predict one of the five prediction states for every retained token; annotation_unknown truth is excluded from metrics and its exact fixed coverage is reported
gold_projection.quantity_scope: operational conventional administrative numeric or count-unit token, not every semantically numeric word
gold_projection.gold_use: future evaluator-side truth only; never a model input or target-eligibility oracle

quantity.estimand: conventional written numeric marker or count-unit token
quantity.mtaac_rule: XPOSTAG matches ^NU(?:[.]|$); the official worked example labels written 3(u) as NU
quantity.oracc_rule: lemma f.pos is lowercase n; ORACC uses this convention for administrative numerals and count-unit graphemes
quantity.comparability: operationally aligned through different source annotation conventions; not every semantic or spelled quantity expression
quantity.oracc_pos_NU: context_only because ORACC NU is a number word rather than the lowercase-n administrative numeric convention

unit.oracc_rule: lemma f.pos is N and f.gw is unit
unit.comparability: aligned guide-word or normalization semantics under different source fields

context_only.estimand: scorable retained token outside the four target projections
context_only.comparability: broad complement class; source-specific composition and prevalence differ and must be reported

support_gate.support_commitment_contract: hash b'indusbench:oracc-ed3b:support-commitment:v1\x00'; in quantity, unit, person_name, settlement_name order append each framed ASCII class name, token count, and supporting-document count; counts are unsigned 8-byte big-endian

reservation.reserved_scope: every qualified document after the fixed audit exclusion
reservation.gold_conditioned_feature_safety_inspecti: class-conditioned GDL-key frequencies were computed and used to remove numeric-parser, determinative, delimiter, form-wrapper, and linguistic metadata leakage; no prediction or performance metric was run
reservation.aggregate_side_information_observed_befo: archive-wide and SumTablets-joined projected class counts listed in support_gate
reservation.distribution_dependent_choice_rule: the complete candidate family, class-balance options, thresholds, and selection rule must be frozen before any selected-source score is computed; the validation must not be described as distribution-blind or feature-unseen
reservation.validation_execution: disabled until the V3 development report, selected candidate, exact implementation commit, thresholds, capability-separated prediction and scoring stages, and one-shot evaluator are separately frozen and publicly committed
reservation.binding_confirmation_role: prohibited; a different previously uninspected corpus must be selected through independent custody or a predeclared public-random mechanism after the complete model and evaluator freeze; an ED3b subset cannot qualify
reservation.source_qualification_inspection: rights, archive integrity, schema, aggregate class support, archive-wide and joined-source class counts, limited now-excluded examples, and gold-conditioned GDL-key safety aggregates were inspected before this freeze

v3_boundary.development_pool: MTAAC V2 training families only for candidate model fitting and selection; the V2 holdout and ORACC records remain prohibited
v3_boundary.source_identifier_intersection_method: compare exact catalogue or source-document identifiers after the fixed ORACC eligibility and audit exclusion against every selected member of the exact pinned MTAAC archive
v3_boundary.future_observation_fingerprint_audit: the post-development validation protocol must bind exact complete-document and line observation overlap diagnostics before scoring; source-identifier separation alone does not prove lexical novelty
v3_boundary.primary_state_space: joint five-state prediction over every retained token
v3_boundary.future_capability_separation: prediction stage receives only canonical observations one document at a time with frozen model, vocabulary, priors, transitions, and normalizers and writes a no-replace prediction commitment before a separate evaluator loads gold; batch test-time fitting, IDF, clustering, calibration, or adaptation is prohibited
v3_boundary.external_model_and_data_gate: primary candidate uses only declared MTAAC-development observations and project-authored synthetic fixtures; pretrained language models, external embeddings or tokenizers, ORACC lexicons or sign-role tables, web or API lookup, and prompts containing validation records are prohibited
v3_boundary.within_source_replica_gate: before scoring, gold-independent canonical document and line fingerprints must freeze ED3b exact and near-duplicate families, MTAAC-to-ED3b overlaps, family-balanced weights, cluster uncertainty, and a novel-template stratum; distinct source identifiers are not independent evidence
v3_boundary.permutation_unit: whole family or document label tensors moved only within frozen compatible line-layout strata

scientific_scope.positive_scope: A rights-cleared, feature-safety-exposed prospective validation source commitment for future project-run evaluation of five-state short administrative sequence recovery.
